name: Daily Operations Scorecard
outcome: Show the owner observed daily counts for inquiries, missed calls, recovered opportunities, bookings, attendance, intake and outstanding work.
required_inputs: Explicit distinction between operational and synthetic demo events
guardrails: Do not invent ROI, conversion rates, or causal effects from separate count totals.
Never mix synthetic demo events with measured clinic outcomes without clear labeling.
No patient identifiers or message bodies in operational metric events.
activation_requirements: Event types and event sources defined.
Provider and staff event capture tested for duplicates and missing events.
Dashboard surfaces the reporting window, data mode, missing coverage and limitations.
